patterns.note: Sticky header that dynamically reduces height and changes background from transparent to solid white upon scroll.
Hero section features a full-bleed video background that remains fixed or subtly scales while text content scrolls over it.
Main content sections employ a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, revealing content progressively.
Prominent 'Ecosystem' section uses a flexible grid to showcase interconnected products, each with an image and brief description.
Strategic use of vibrant accent colors (purple, pink) for call-to-action buttons and 'New' labels against a largely neutral palette of whites, greys, and dark tones.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that uses JavaScript to detect scroll position, dynamically reducing its height and changing its background from transparent to a solid color (e.g., white) after a certain scroll threshold.
The hero section utilizes a full-width video as a background element (video-hero), with text and a call-to-action button positioned centrally on top, creating an immersive and dynamic introduction.

Sections below the hero are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, such as a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect, applied to individual content blocks as they become visible in the user's viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clear hierarchy with large, clean sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) and legible body text, maintaining good contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on product cards and buttons, creating a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with airy hero and main content sections, transitioning to a more information-dense footer.

standout: The site effectively combines sophisticated health technology with a clean, approachable, and visually appealing design. The use of a video hero to immediately convey the product's innovation, coupled with a well-structured 'Ecosystem' section, makes complex offerings feel integrated and user-friendly.
